parties.respondent: Baldev Singh (D) Through His Lrs & Ors

summary: Specific performance decree execution; conditional deposit period expired during appeal; High Court restored trial decree without fixing new timeline; Section 28 Specific Relief Act rescission claim rejected; executing court permitted deposit after four months; no willful default or unreasonable delay established; merger doctrine applied; dismissal of revision petitions upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment affirmed; rescission application dismissed; execution proceedings validated.
